skill_traces.query:
Evan: Hey Sam, long time no talk! Hope you're doing great. I just got back from a rad vacay with my new SO in Canada. Tried some awesome activities too - think hiking, biking... all that cool stuff. We loved exploring the outdoors together, it was so awesome!
Sam: Hey Evan! Good to hear from you. Wow, Canada sounds amazing! That photo looks stunning. Wish I could do something like that. Things have been a bit challenging for me lately; some stuff has been hard on my health.
Evan: Sorry to hear that things haven't been going well. Dealing with health issues can be tough. Is there anything I can do to help?
Sam: Thanks, Evan. Your support means a lot to me. It's tough staying positive, but knowing I have people like you in my corner makes it easier.
Evan: Glad to support you, Sam. Surrounding ourselves with people who care is key. What's on that note? A reminder or quote to stay motivated?
Sam: Yeah, it's actually a quote that's been helping me stay motivated. It reminds me that progress is more important than perfection. Taking small steps towards a healthier life is still progress.
Evan: Cool mindset, Sam! I totally agree, progress over perfection. Mind sharing the quote with me? I would love to get something out of it too.
Sam: "Don't fear it, just take the first step. It's been helping me move forward to healthier habits!"
Evan: Love the quote, Sam. That mindset really helps me too. Thanks!
Sam: You're welcome! Glad it helps. These times can be challenging.
Evan: They can be tough, but remember to celebrate the small wins - every step forward counts!
Sam: You're absolutely right! Celebrating those small wins is crucial. It's easy to get caught up in the challenges and setbacks, but those little victories are what keep me motivated. Thanks for the reminder, it's much appreciated.
Evan: Absolutely, Sam. Remember, every small victory is a step forward, so keep up the good work! I'm cheering for you! And hey, I could use some cheering too - I've been searching for my keys for the last half hour with no luck! I'm losing it every week..
Sam: Oh, I'll definitely be your cheerleader once I get some sleep, Evan! Funny you mention that, I had this amazing dream last night where I was soaring over skyscrapers. It felt incredible! Makes me wonder what it signifies...
Evan: That does sound like an amazing dream! Maybe you should check out a dream interpretation book; it could offer some insights. Sweet dreams, Sam!
Sam: Thanks for the suggestion, Evan. I'll look into it. This journey feels endless at times, but I'm convinced it's going to be rewarding in the end. So good luck with your keys, Evan!
Evan: I'll just keep going, step by step, and I'll definitely find those keys!
Sam: That's for sure!
Evan: Go to bed already, bud! And take care!

selected.name: Extract Statements of Personal Significance
selected.description: Use when a user says an object, photo, or item reminds them of someone or something, or has personal meaning.
content: During extraction, when a user describes an object, photo, or item as reminding them of someone or something ('reminds me of', 'makes me think of', 'means ... to me'), create a candidate state memory capturing the connection.
Record who is reminded (the speaker), the object, and what it reminds them of (person, feeling, or value) in the speaker's own words.
Treat such statements as durable personal facts even though they are phrased as effects or feelings, not as direct assertions; extract at most one memory per statement.
selected.rerank_reason: Sam mentions a quote that reminds him of progress over perfection, which is a statement of personal significance.

selected.name: Extract Explicit Goals and Intended Impact
selected.description: Use when a message states a hope, goal, dream, or intended impact for an activity or interest.
content: During extraction, if a message explicitly states a user's goal, hope, aspiration, or intended impact for an activity (e.g., share stories, make a difference, reach others), capture it as a separate facet in the memory content; do not replace it with only current emotional benefits like escape, expression, or healing.
When enriching an existing memory, preserve previously stored facets and ADD the newly stated goal or impact rather than overwriting the memory with a narrower paraphrase.
Stop after capturing the explicit goal and its immediate context; do not enumerate every possible future hope or infer unstated ambitions.
selected.rerank_reason: Sam explicitly states his goal of staying motivated through small steps and progress, which is an intended impact for his health journey.

nearby_not_selected.name: Extract Inspiration and Plan Memories
nearby_not_selected.description: Use when a user mentions what inspired or motivated their current or future project.
content: During extraction, treat statements like 'X sparked ideas for my [project]' as a plan/state memory candidate.
Do not skip a turn just because it contains no direct question; extract motivation and project details from casual narrative.
Resolve relative time from the message/session timestamp and include it in the memory.

nearby_not_selected.name: Extract Comfort and Joy Sources
nearby_not_selected.description: Use when a message states that something cheers the user up, brings joy, or provides comfort.
content: During extraction, if the user mentions a pet, hobby, person, item, or activity that provides cheer, comfort, or emotional support, create a separate durable memory (preference, relationship, or state) capturing that source, even when the message also contains stress or negative events.
Do not merge the supportive source only into a negative-event candidate; it should be its own candidate so it survives later SKIP/MERGE decisions.
Extract only sources explicitly stated as supportive; do not infer unmentioned ones.

nearby_not_selected.name: Location Qualifiers for Named Destination Plans
nearby_not_selected.description: When extracting or updating a plan memory that mentions a specific named venue, landmark, or business, include its commonly known location(s) so future location questions can be answered.
content: During extraction, if a plan memory mentions a specific named venue, landmark, or business, add a concise qualifier naming its well-known location(s), e.g., US states or countries.
Use only common knowledge about that entity; do not research or speculate beyond obvious, widely known locations.
If one location is commonly known, record it; if several prominent locations exist, record all commonly known ones, then stop.
Apply the same qualifier when updating an existing plan memory that references the venue.

nearby_not_selected.name: Preserve Specific Plan Details in Event Memory Extraction
nearby_not_selected.description: When extracting an event or plan memory and messages state what participants will try, do, or consume, include those concrete details in the memory content.
content: During extraction of event/plan memories, if messages explicitly state what participants will try, do, or consume (e.g., a specific dish, drink, or activity), preserve those concrete items in the memory content instead of replacing them with a generic label like 'date' or 'meet up'.
When the same plan is mentioned across multiple messages, merge the explicitly stated specifics into one memory record, but do not add details that were not said.

nearby_not_selected.name: Extract Objects as Reminders of Values
nearby_not_selected.description: Use when a speaker mentions a physical object that serves as a reminder, symbol, or inspiration for a personal value or goal.
content: During extraction, when a speaker describes an object as a reminder or symbol of a value or goal, create a `state` candidate for the object and a `preference` candidate for the value/goal.
Use the speaker's exact wording and message evidence to link both candidates.
During CRUD, this rule requires no special handling; process candidates normally.
